task_completion.description: Navigate to the specified story URL in Firefox.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox address bar shows 'http://localhost:8080/story.html' and the page content (story with sidebars/ads) is visible.
The Reader View icon in the address bar is highlighted/active, and the page layout changes to a clean, centered text format without sidebars.

task_completion.description: Open the Firefox print menu or system print dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A print settings overlay or dialog box is visible over the Firefox window.

task_completion.description: Select 'Save to PDF' or 'Print to File' as the destination.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The destination dropdown or printer selection in the print dialog shows 'Save to PDF' or 'Print to File'.

task_completion.description: Save the file with the exact name 'clean_story.pdf' in the Documents folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file picker or save dialog shows the path '~/Documents/clean_story.pdf' or 'clean_story.pdf' being entered before confirmation.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to move or create the PDF.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent interacts with the Firefox GUI (menus, buttons, dialogs) rather than typing 'mv' or 'cp' commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent used the actual Reader View feature rather than just zooming in or cropping.
integrity.visual_evidence: The specific Firefox Reader View icon (document icon) in the URL bar is toggled, and the Reader View sidebar (font/color controls) appears.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the browser's print interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the sequence of clicking the Firefox menu or using shortcuts to trigger the native print UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is http://localhost:8080/story.html. Reader View is only available in Firefox when the 'Enter Reader View' icon (or F9) is triggered. The final file must be named 'clean_story.pdf' and located in the Documents directory. The PDF content should reflect the stripped-down version of the page, not the original cluttered version.
